item.title: Would Sacramento voters send a Republican to Congress? Kevin Kiley is betting on it
item.description: Kiley's much-anticipated decision comes after Prop. 50 turned the two-term congressman's current district solidly Democratic and left him with no easy path to reelection.

item.title: Californians despair about high cost of living. This housing can help
item.description: Factory-built housing could bring down construction and housing costs in California, which has the highest cost of living in the country.

item.title: A podcaster gave Newsom a gun. Are California laws keeping him from taking it home?
item.description: Last year, conservative podcaster Shawn Ryan gave Gavin Newsom a SIG Sauer handgun, which the governor has yet to take home. To do so, Newsom would have to navigate a complicated web of California gun laws.

item.title: California colleges spend millions on faulty AI systems: ‘The chatbot is outdated’
item.description: Community colleges are spending millions on AI-powered chatbots that students say often give inaccurate answers. Many might see upgrades this year.

item.title: Free speech or conspiracy? Courts limit protesters’ First Amendment rights
item.description: Prosecutors are charging protesters with conspiracy, seeking to limit opposition to government policies. More courts are allowing it.

item.title: Is California’s ski season deadlier than usual? Here’s why we don’t know
item.description: A deadly ski season in California raises urgent questions. Why doesn’t the state track resort injuries or deaths, and who’s protecting people on the slopes?

item.title: Estudiantes universitarios pueden ganar $10,000 por marcar una diferencia en las comunidades de California
item.description: El popular programa College Corps paga a estudiantes hasta $10,000 por servicio comunitario, incluyendo tutorías para jóvenes encarcelados, asistencia en bancos de alimentos y más. El programa se está expandiendo de 45 a 52 campus, incorporando a cientos de estudiantes más.

item.title: GOP Rep. Darrell Issa to retire rather than run in redrawn San Diego district
item.description: The 12-term congressman said Friday that he will not seek reelection in his new district, which was redrawn after Prop. 50 to favor Democrats.

item.title: The field is set: Meet the candidates officially running for California governor
item.description: Eight Democrats and two Republicans have filed officially to run for California governor by the Friday deadline. The crowded field could give GOP candidates a boost.
